description: This file contains API functions for managing and retrieving information about organizations (tenants), including listing organizations and fetching organization summaries, with external API calls and data normalization.

methods.name: listOrganizations
methods.description: Fetches and returns a sorted list of organizations (tenants) with normalized IDs and names.

methods.name: getOrganizationSummary
methods.description: Builds and returns a summary for a specific tenant, including total cost and user count, with optional navigation data fetch.
